Cost Per Dose: 50eb (Costly)

For a jolt of jiggly juice on the go! Note: Not recommended for daily use. Try not to overdo it on this stuff, or else you’re likely to sap all your strength.

⋙ PRIMARY EFFECT ⋘

  • Lasts 4 hours.
  • For the duration of the Primary Effect, the user’s DEX is increased by 1 to a maximum of 8.
  • For the duration of the Primary Effect, if the user is also experiencing the Primary Effect of Synthcoke, their BODY and WILL are reduced by 2 (Minimum 1). This reduction in BODY and WILL does not reduce or modify the user’s HP, and is not factored in when calculating their Death Save.
  • Users become extremely hyper-active and struggle to resist impulses or remain still. Do your best to roleplay accordingly.

⋙ SECONDARY EFFECT (DV17) ⋘

  • If the user wasn’t addicted to Jellytricity, they are now. While addicted, unless the user is currently experiencing the Primary Effect of Jellytricity, their DEX is reduced by 2 (Minimum 1).
  • While addicted to Jellytricity, unless the user is currently experiencing the Primary Effect of Jellytricity, they feel sluggish and have an oddly powerful craving for gelatinous foodstuffs. Do your best to roleplay accordingly.

Cost: 50eb (Costly) per dose
Type: Street Drug

Foundry notes:

  • Primary (4 hours): DEX +1, to a maximum of 8 (check the cap by hand).
  • While addicted, switch on the "Jellytricity Addiction" effect.
  • When an addicted character doses, use "Jellytricity Addicted Primary" instead of the normal primary effect; it cancels the withdrawal penalties for the duration.
  • Stat and skill changes are automated; caps, minimums, durations, and everything else are not.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Gear, Drugs, & Frames > Consumables > Street Drugs).
